historicalContext.reason: Historical v1 endless master2026102303 differs from v2 master2026102603 and active policy changed1 to2. This is unpaired background; no paired improvement or causal attribution is asserted.

limitations: Each strategy/layout denominator remains20, including campaign deaths and other nonentrants; conditional depth20 TTK explicitly uses the same successful run identities at depths5/10/20.
Successful duration percentiles use naturally completed target20 runs only. Deaths never enter success medians; budgets, errors, cancellations and invalid values are never relabelled deaths.

TTK observes defeated entities only, includes approach time, and censors surviving entities. Histogram counts are exact; rank intervals and upper bounds are not exact medians or attack-count evidence. Fusion donors are not kills.
A TTK at most1second is a lifetime measure and cannot establish that a unit died to exactly one hit.

Native warning/interrupt/release telemetry spans all fixed steps and is reconciled to mechanic counts. Starts need not equal interrupts plus releases because casts can end with entity death or stage/run cancellation.

HP-loss totals include sacrifice self-cost, separated by source; maximum1second hostile HP/damage windows exclude that self-cost. Shield absorption and healing remain separate real observations; no universal no-one-shot guarantee is inferred.

Training score is earned credit, not number of trainings or the nonlinear acquisition-cost curve. Kill role credits exactly reconcile to native kill sources; fusion donors are not credited as killed entities.

Survivor TTK and attrition are observations for root's late-challenge acceptance. Complete strict sampling alone does not prove flat progression fixed, human win rates, device smoothness, browser acceptance or release readiness.
Historical v1 remains rejected and unchanged; different seeds and changed active policy permit unpaired background only.
